Rscript - <<'RS'
load('/data/ratingData5')
ratingData5$correspondingTime <- as.factor(ratingData5$correspondingTime)
ratingData5$USval <- ifelse(substr(as.character(ratingData5$correspondingUS), 1, 1) == 'p', 'positive', 'negative')
ratingData5$USval <- as.factor(ratingData5$USval)
ratingData5Aggr <- aggregate(ratingData5$likingRating, by = list(ParticipantNumber=ratingData5$ParticipantNumber, USval=ratingData5$USval, correspondingTime=ratingData5$correspondingTime), FUN=mean)
names(ratingData5Aggr)[4] <- 'likingRating'
library(tidyr)
ratingData5AggrW <- spread(ratingData5Aggr, key='USval', value='likingRating')
ratingData5AggrW$EC <- ratingData5AggrW$positive - ratingData5AggrW$negative
print(aggregate(EC ~ correspondingTime, ratingData5AggrW, mean))
RS
